verdict.rationale: Loops' CLI can 'test transactional email' and 'test your integration', and `--team` switches between workspaces. Neither is a documented sandbox or test mode isolated from production data: the testing still runs against the live account, and keeping a separate workspace would be a user-side workaround. Draft campaigns are a review step before sending, not an isolated environment, so nothing in the evidence shows a sandbox capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
